crop.notes: The Allen notice is the first paragraph; the rest of the clipping is the unrelated 'Amusements / National Opera' item.

ocr.notes: Accurate except 'Smith' read as 'hagede' and 'bar' split.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a notice for Tom Allen, "the retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening and showing Smith and Kilrain's colors at the bar.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Republican: St. Louis, Saturday Morning, December 3, 1887', page 6; before 1888 the paper is filed as the Missouri Republican, not the St. Louis Republic.

facts.fact: Allen ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening and displaying Jem Smith's and Jake Kilrain's colors at the bar

notes: Same notice appeared the same day in the Globe-Democrat (article 745).
